metadata.description: License tier this template is packaged for (community | standard | professional). Informational; drives resource tags only.
Number of pre-created compute slots in the pool (the license node ceiling minus the 1 always-on embedded node on the platform).
Location for all resources.
Short prefix for resource names. Lowercase letters and digits.
DeltaForge Platform container image. Defaults to the published public image; override only for a private/air-gapped registry.
DeltaForge Compute (worker) container image run by every slot in the pool. Defaults to the published public image.
DeltaForge GUI container image (browser GUI, HTTP-serving headless mode) for the dedicated GUI app. Defaults to the published public image.

Deploy the client apps (GUI + compute slots). Staged-deploy gate: deploy once with false (Postgres + the authoritative server only), wait for the server to finish bootstrapping the shared catalog, then deploy again with true to bring up the GUI and compute slots against a seeded database. ARM dependsOn orders resource CREATION but not runtime READINESS, so this gate is what enforces pg -> server-bootstrapped -> gui/compute.
Shared secret the compute slots register with (NODE_SECRET). Auto-generated per deployment; no need to supply one.
Private registry login server (e.g. <acr>.azurecr.io). Leave empty to pull the default public images.
Private registry username. Only needed when registryServer is set.
Private registry password / token. Only needed when registryServer is set.
Root init image (chowns the NFS /data mount for the non-root engine). Microsoft Container Registry, no Docker Hub rate limit.
vCPU for the Platform container (Consumption: 0.25-4).
Memory for the Platform container (e.g. 4Gi). Must pair with cpuCores.
vCPU for each compute slot container (Consumption: 0.25-4).
Memory for each compute slot container (e.g. 4Gi). Must pair with slotCpuCores.
Seeded admin account email.
Seeded engineer account email.

DeltaForge license key. Leave empty to auto-provision a Community license on first boot: the platform exchanges its managed-identity token with the DeltaForge console (subscription-attested), so a Marketplace buyer needs no pre-obtained key. Supply a key only to pin a purchased/higher tier.
DeltaForge console (license service) base URL used for subscription-attested auto-provisioning when no licenseKey is supplied.
Premium NFS file share size (GiB) for /data. Premium minimum is 100.

Vault entry id holding the Azure service-principal credential the provisioner uses to flip slot minReplicas via ARM. Empty at deploy time: the operator creates the SP + vault entry post-deploy (see README-slot-pool.md) and re-applies. Wired into DELTA_FORGE_SCALING_CREDENTIAL_REF.
